title.narrative: IMS innovation funds: Youth Online Navigation - AI as a Game Changer

description.narrative: Social media platforms have emerged as vital spaces for democratic debate and dialogue specially for young generations. However, the rise of hate speech and slurs is increasingly undermining these discussions. At the same time, artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming every sector, including the field of human rights. With its current capabilities, AI can be developed to effectively moderate online spaces and help restore a safe space for this public discourse. It's time to harness this potential. The overall goal of the project is to use AI to develop a highly innovative tool serving the promotion of inclusive online spaces with less hate speech across the MENA region through more innovative and effective moderation of social media.
